First Aid Reference

Searchable quick-reference cards for common first-aid situations: CPR, choking, bleeding, burns, and more.

🚨 In a real emergency, call emergency services FIRST (911 / 112 / 15 in Pakistan) — then follow these steps while help is on the way.

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Take a certified first-aid course; this reference cannot replace training.

📖 How to use

  1. Search for the situation (e.g. choking, burns).
  2. Tap a card to expand its steps.
  3. Follow the steps while help is on the way.
  4. Call emergency services first in any real emergency.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I use this reference?

Type in the search box — cards filter instantly. Tap a card to expand its step-by-step instructions.

Does this replace first-aid training?

No — it is a memory aid for trained responders, not a substitute for professional training or emergency care.

What is the first thing to do in an emergency?

Call your local emergency number immediately (e.g. 911, 112, 15 in Pakistan) before doing anything else.
